scope: Targeted primary-source overlap check, not a complete novelty review.

sources.evidence: HTGS section3.2/3.3 evaluates perspective-correct Gaussian response and maximum-contribution depth using an inversion-free Plucker formulation. General exact-perspective splat evaluation is established.
3DGUT Eq11 gives exact maximum response distance and factor-space expression. It treats projected conics as an acceleration structure and evaluates response in 3D.
2DGS uses perspective-correct ray-splat intersection for planar primitives; distinct representation and not an unexamined new baseline.
DU-Shapley Eq4 describes the standard permutation-average marginal contribution used for the three-factor diagnostic; it is not a new allocation method.
